common.tagline: Report issues in your town in under a minute.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.notAllowed: You are not allowed to do this.

home.title: Your town, one tap away
home.subtitle: Spotted a pothole, a broken street light or have an idea for your neighbourhood? Pin it on the map and your municipality takes it from there.
home.notFound: Your location is not inside a municipality that uses OpenCityVoice yet.
home.locationDenied: Location access was denied. Choose your municipality from the list.

steps.oneText: Snap the problem with your phone.
steps.twoText: We use your GPS, you can adjust the pin.
steps.threeText: Get an e-mail when the status changes.

home.forMunicipalitiesText: A central map of all reports, workflow statuses, assignments to responsible people and forwarding by e-mail. Free and open source.

auth.title: Sign in to OpenCityVoice
auth.subtitle: Signing in lets you report issues, vote and comment. Browsing is open to everyone.
auth.checkEmailText: We sent a sign-in link and a 6-digit code to {email}.
auth.invalidCode: The code is invalid or has expired.
auth.terms: By continuing you accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>. Your name and reports are shown publicly; your e-mail address is never published.

explorer.reports: {count, plural, =0 {No reports} one {# report} other {# reports}}

report.supporters: {count, plural, =0 {No supporters yet} one {# supporter} other {# supporters}}
report.commentPlaceholder: Share an update or additional information
report.signInToComment: Sign in to comment and support this report.
report.shareText: More support helps the municipality prioritise. Share it with neighbours.
report.shareMessage: {title} – support this report in {municipality} on OpenCityVoice
report.duplicateOf: This report is a duplicate and was merged into <link>#{number}</link>. Follow it there.

newReport.title: Report an issue
newReport.photoText: A photo helps the municipality understand the issue faster. If the photo contains GPS data we use it to place the pin.
newReport.locationText: Move the map so the pin points to the exact spot.
newReport.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Deep pothole at the crossing
newReport.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the issue. Where exactly is it, since when, how dangerous is it?
newReport.successText: Your report #{number} has been submitted. We will e-mail you when its status changes.
newReport.duplicatesText: Is it one of these? Support it or add a new photo in a comment instead of submitting a new report.
newReport.rateLimited: You have submitted many reports in a short time. Please try again later.
newReport.nearbyTitle: {count, plural, one {# report already nearby} other {# reports already nearby}}
newReport.nearbyText: If it is the same issue, support it or add a new photo in a comment.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.name: Name
profile.namePlaceholder: Your name as shown on reports
profile.emailNotificationsText: Get an e-mail when the status of your report changes.
profile.noReports: You have not reported anything yet.

join.title: Join {municipality} as a responsible person
join.text: Municipality staff and responsible people (e.g. utility companies) can manage reports. An administrator of the municipality has to approve your request.
join.pending: Your request is waiting for approval.
join.rejected: Your request was rejected. Contact the municipality for details.

manage.selectReport: Select a report on the map or in the list.
manage.statusNotePlaceholder: Optional, included in the e-mail and timeline
manage.forwardText: The recipient gets a link to a read-only page with all details of the report. No account is needed.
manage.deleteReportConfirm: Delete this report permanently? This cannot be undone.
manage.markDuplicateText: If the same issue is already reported, merge this report into it. Supporters move over and the author is notified.
manage.mergeFailed: Could not merge. Check the report number.

team.title: Team and responsible people
team.text: Approved members can manage reports. Admins can also manage the team and settings.
team.inviteLinkText: Share this link with people who should get access. They sign in and request access, you approve them here.
team.addByEmail: Add a registered user by e-mail
team.userNotFound: No user with this e-mail. Ask them to sign in to OpenCityVoice first, or share the join link.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.mapCenterText: Pan and zoom the map to the default view, then save.
settings.boundaryText: Upload a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon. Reports outside the boundary show a warning.
settings.invalidGeojson: The file is not a valid GeoJSON polygon.
settings.categoriesText: Categories citizens can choose from. Deactivate a category to hide it without losing existing reports.
settings.statusesText: Workflow statuses. New reports get the initial status. Closed statuses count as finished.
settings.inUse: This item is used by existing reports. Deactivate it instead.
settings.logoText: Shown next to the municipality name in the app and in e-mails. PNG, JPG or WebP up to 1 MB; a square image works best.
settings.logoTooLarge: The logo must be smaller than 1 MB.

admin.title: Platform administration
admin.lookupText: Fills in the name, map centre and boundary from OpenStreetMap.
admin.adminEmailText: Must be a registered user. You can add more people later.
admin.slugTaken: This slug is already in use.

forward.title: Report #{number} forwarded by {municipality}
forward.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.

email.statusIntro: The status of your report "{title}" in {municipality} is now: {status}.
email.unsubscribe: You receive this e-mail because notifications are enabled in your OpenCityVoice profile. You can turn them off at {url}.
email.memberApprovedIntro: Your request to manage reports in {municipality} was approved.
email.newReportIntro: A new report was submitted in {category}: "{title}".
email.commentIntro: {name} commented on report #{number} "{title}", which is assigned to you.
email.staffFooter: You receive this e-mail because of your notification settings in the municipality team. Change them at {url}.
email.flagReportIntro: A user flagged report #{number} “{title}” as inappropriate.
email.flagCommentIntro: A user flagged a comment on report #{number} “{title}” as inappropriate.
email.mergedIntro: {municipality} merged your report #{number} into report #{target}, which describes the same issue. Your support was carried over, and you will receive status updates for #{target}.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page you are looking for does not exist.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose which e-mails you receive as a member of the {municipality} team.
notifications.newReportsText: Get an e-mail when a report is submitted in one of the selected categories.
notifications.commentsText: Get an e-mail when someone comments on a report assigned to you.
notifications.notMember: Notifications are available to approved members of the municipality team.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.intro: Content flagged by users. Hidden content is not public; its author and staff can still see it.
moderation.flagHelp: For example offensive content, personal data, faces or licence plates, or advertising. A moderator will review it.
moderation.flagged: Thanks, a moderator will review it.
moderation.hiddenNotice: This report is hidden. Only its author and municipality staff can see it.

legal.independent: Independent citizen initiative. {municipality} does not run this site and does not receive reports automatically.
